items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the prose piece 'Journey to the End of the Earth', and answer.

"The scientist held up a vial of seawater no bigger than a finger. 'There are thousands of living things in here,' she told the students, 'too small to see. They make the air you breathe and feed every fish in this ocean. If they go, everything else follows.' The students looked at the clear water as if it had suddenly become precious."

Why did the water suddenly seem "precious" to the students?
items.answer: They realised how vital the invisible life in it is.
items.markingKey: They realised how vital the invisible life in it is. (1–2 marks for a complete answer.)
